chapter.heading: Jeremiah 21
Jerusalem Will Fall to Nebuchadnezzar
chapter.v: all his wonderful deeds and will make him withdraw from us.”
Then Jeremiah said to them: “Thus you shall say to Zedekiah,
And I will bring them together into the midst of this city.
in anger and in fury and in great wrath.
And I will strike down the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast. They shall die of a great pestilence.
He shall not pity them or spare them or have compassion.’
I set before you the way of life and the way of death.
and shall have his life as a prize of war.
it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.’
“And to the house of the king of Judah say, ‘Hear the word of the Lord ,
or who shall enter our habitations?’
and it shall devour all that is around her.”
